label: BASELINE_B_DESIGN_V1
rationale: Baseline A fails because it tracks the aggregate foreground centroid rather than the diver specifically. Baseline B isolates the primary foreground agent (the diver) before trajectory analysis.

algorithm_stages.name: Background subtraction
algorithm_stages.method: MOG2 (same as Baseline A, identical parameters)

algorithm_stages.name: Connected component isolation
algorithm_stages.method: cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats on morphologically-cleaned foreground mask. Select the LARGEST component by area at each frame.
algorithm_stages.output: diver_blob: bounding box (x, y, w, h) + centroid (cx, cy) per frame
algorithm_stages.rationale_vs_A: Replaces whole-frame centroid with largest-blob centroid. Pool turbulence and background agents produce smaller blobs and are excluded.

algorithm_stages.name: Diver presence detection
algorithm_stages.method: Diver is present in frame when: (a) largest component area > MIN_DIVER_AREA_PX, (b) component present for at least MIN_PRESENCE_FRAMES consecutive frames.
algorithm_stages.rationale_vs_A: Eliminates early spurious foreground activations from noise or background clutter that activate fewer than 5 consecutive frames.

algorithm_stages.name: Trajectory extraction
algorithm_stages.method: Extract y_centroid of diver blob for all presence_mask=True frames. Invert y so that higher in frame = higher value (y_norm = (frame_height - y_centroid) / frame_height).
algorithm_stages.output: trajectory: array of (frame_idx, y_norm) for diver-present frames

algorithm_stages.name: Trajectory smoothing
algorithm_stages.method: Savitzky-Golay filter (window=11, poly=3) on y_norm, same as Baseline A.

takeoff.definition: First frame in the diver-present window where the smoothed y_norm exceeds TAKEOFF_THRESHOLD and the diver is moving upward (dy/dt > 0).
takeoff.parameter: TAKEOFF_THRESHOLD = 0.35 (diver must be above 35% of frame height, normalized)
takeoff.rationale: Diver starts below board/platform level; takeoff is the first upward movement from the board.

apex.definition: Frame of maximum y_norm (highest vertical position) in the diver-present window, located after takeoff.
apex.rationale: Apex is simply the peak of the trajectory; no ambiguity after diver isolation.

water_contact.definition: Last frame where diver_blob is detected (presence ends), OR the frame where y_norm drops most steeply below WATER_LEVEL_THRESHOLD after apex.
water_contact.rationale: Once the diver submerges, the largest blob disappears or drops below the waterline. Post-entry turbulence is a smaller blob and does not trigger the primary tracker.

training_constraint: Parameters selected by inspection of DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN dives only. INTERNAL_EVAL dives must not be used for parameter selection.
expected_improvements_vs_A: TRAJECTORY_COLLAPSE: eliminated by using largest-blob centroid instead of whole-frame centroid
EARLY_TRIGGER: reduced by MIN_PRESENCE_FRAMES gate and TAKEOFF_THRESHOLD height requirement
WATER_CONTACT_RUNAWAY: addressed by tracking blob disappearance rather than signal peaks
LATE_FIRE: partially addressed; diver isolation may sharpen the onset signal
limitations: Still relies on MOG2 for foreground detection; poor performance with very slow-moving divers or static backgrounds
Largest-blob heuristic may fail if a coach or another athlete is closer to the camera than the diver
No person class verification (not a person detector); blob could be a large lane-line or equipment element
Platform height prior (TAKEOFF_THRESHOLD) is a single value; may not generalise across pool setups
